warnings.title: attract magnet telegraph misses upgrades of non-representative parallel-bundle pipes
warnings.evidence: for k in 0..<int(ac) { if after.hops[int(ao)+k].pipe == pipe { attract = true; break } }  — but Hop.pipe is the bundle's lowest-slot representative (routing.odin:33-37); parallel pipes between a pair are legal (validate_draw).
warnings.detail: Upgrading a parallel pipe that is not the lowest-slot rep genuinely re-prices the edge (min semantics) and attracts traffic through the bundle, yet attract stays false — the telegraph under-reports.
warnings.recommended_fix: Set attract when any live pipe sharing the hop's (from,neighbor) pair is the upgraded pipe, not only on rep-id equality.

warnings.title: "N flows" labels pair counts — Route_Shift entries are (from,dst) pairs, not packet flows
warnings.evidence: magnet := 0; for s in prev.shifts { if s.attract { magnet += 1 } }; m := fmt.aprintf("attracts %d %s", magnet, ...) — one Route_Shift entry per (from,dst) pair.
warnings.detail: The magnet telegraph and per-kind rows aggregate one entry per shifted node pair, then render "N flows". The demo spawns four packets per pair — the displayed number understates real flow movement.
warnings.recommended_fix: Relabel the aggregation unit (e.g. "affects N routes") or count actual demand flows per pair.

warnings.title: tiers scratch sized by len(pipe_alive) but filled by len(pipe_tier) — latent OOB write
warnings.evidence: tiers := make([]u16, len(t.pipe_alive)); defer delete(tiers); for i in 0..<len(t.pipe_tier) { tiers[i] = t.pipe_tier[i] }
warnings.detail: Allocation bound differs from copy-loop bound. Safe today: both arrays are appended in lockstep (topology.odin:187,191) and never shrink. A future divergence would panic or read stale slots.
warnings.recommended_fix: Size the scratch by len(t.pipe_tier) (the loop's bound) and assert the two lengths match.

warnings.title: Preview-card rendering branches (overflow cap, zero-shift line, magnet, pluralization) untested
warnings.evidence: else if nrows < MAX_PREVIEW_ROWS { ... } else { overflow += 1 }; draw_text_c(v, "no reroute predicted", ...); flow_word :: proc(n: i32) -> string
warnings.detail: The >12-bucket overflow tail, empty-shift line, magnet aggregation, singular/plural conjugation and the "?" fallback have no unit or golden coverage — these branches produce the exact text players read.
warnings.recommended_fix: Move Preview_Row aggregation + preview_row_line/flow_word into pure procs with @(test) pins; capture a dense and an empty preview card as goldens.

notes.title: routing_rebuild_with_tiers indexes the caller-supplied tiers slice without length validation
notes.evidence: routing_rebuild_with_tiers :: proc(r: ^Routing_Table, t: ^Topology, cat: ^Catalogs, tiers: []u16, allocator := context.allocator) { ... nd := dist[cur] + cat.pipe_tiers[tiers[pi]].cost
notes.detail: The new public seam accepts an arbitrary tiers slice and indexes tiers[pi] up to len(pipe_alive)-1. Both current callers pass matching lengths — latent hardening, not a live read.
notes.recommended_fix: Guard the seam: if len(tiers) < len(t.pipe_alive) return (or assert) before the Dijkstra loops.

notes.title: Preview card duplicates the weather card's chrome and layout math
notes.evidence: card := rl.Color{255, 252, 244, 235}; rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, h, card); border := rl.Color{51, 65, 79, 40}; rl.DrawRectangleLines(...) — identical block in both draw_forecast_panel and draw_upgrade_preview.
notes.detail: Identical translucent-card + border rects and height math inlined twice; a third panel would copy it again and the card look can drift across copies.
notes.recommended_fix: Extract a small draw_card(v, x, y, w, h) helper in the render package.

notes.title: The preview's commit leg is unwalkable in the live app — no demolish input exists (pre-existing)
notes.evidence: git log -S "Cmd_Demolish_Pipe" -- app/main.odin → empty; handle_input binds only U/1/2/E/S/B; the launchable increment says 'select a pipe → U → panel predicts → demolish+redraw → ...'.
notes.detail: Demolish was never wired into the app (2.3 shipped without an app binding). The commit leg of the Verify loop is walkable only in the demo; the PR body hedges to demo+pin. Adding a demolish key would violate the no-new-player-commands scope guard.
notes.recommended_fix: Either descope the in-app commit to a follow-up job explicitly in the PR body, or note the walkable surface is the demo until demolish input lands.

notes.title: Disarm paths leave preview_shifts allocated until re-arm or run end
notes.evidence: if !ok { app.preview_active = false; return }; if u32(cur) + 1 >= u32(len(app.cat.pipe_tiers)) { app.preview_active = false; return }
notes.detail: Disarming (pipe gone, widest tier, deselect) clears preview_active but never delete(app.preview_shifts); stale storage lingers until the next recompute swap or start_run. Bounded, but inconsistent with the app-owned/freed contract.
notes.recommended_fix: delete(app.preview_shifts) on every disarm path before returning.

notes.title: Route_Shift display fields (attract-on-split, old_pipe) and same-cost-different-tier path unasserted
notes.evidence: test_forecast_split_equal_cost asserts kind/counts/next but not attract or old_pipe; no test asserts old_pipe anywhere; the 'same-cost DIFFERENT tier' honesty comment has no pin.
notes.detail: A magnet overcount/undercount on ties, or a regression in old_pipe, would go unnoticed.
notes.recommended_fix: Extend the split pin with attract == true and old_pipe assertions; add a same-cost-different-tier case asserting an empty shift list.

notes.title: Preview card height is one line (20px) too tall whenever shifts exist
notes.evidence: lines := 2 + nrows; if magnet > 0 { lines += 1 }; if overflow > 0 { lines += 1 }; h := title_h + i32(lines) * line_h + pad — drawn content after the title is sub(1) + [magnet] + nrows + [overflow] = 1 + nrows(+1)(+1).
notes.detail: With shifts present the card bottom extends one blank line_h past the last row (only the zero-shift case is exact: 2 drawn vs 2). Cosmetic, app-only — invisible to harness goldens.
notes.recommended_fix: lines := 1 + nrows (+ magnet/overflow flags) in draw_upgrade_preview.
